To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) we propose a new framework based on seq2seq models which is more holistic and extendable than existing pipeline based approaches; (2) we propose a simple Two Stage CopyNet (TSC) model which significantly reduces model complexity and achieves state of the art performance on large datasets.

we propose a novel framework for task oriented dialogue systems which can be optimized by supervised or reinforcement learning; that we design belief spans to model task oriented dialogue systems in a seq2sec way, allowing for a simplistic Two Stage copynet instantiation; and that our approach significantly outperforms pipeline based methods in terms of model complexity and entity match rates on large datasets and on OOV cases.

(1) task oriented dialogue systems can be modeled in a holistic way with single sequence to sequence architectures; (2) a simple Two Stage CopyNet model can be trained in minutes and outperforms the state of the art by a significant margin; (3) it is robust to OOV cases, which is not the case for pipeline designed methods.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: 1) How do we model a task oriented dialogue system in a seq2 seq way, and what is the impact of this modeling on the performance of the task oriented dialogue systems?
the following questions: (1) Can task oriented dialogue systems be designed with single seq2seq models instead of the pipeline based methods?
the question how to simplify task oriented dialogue systems with seq2seq architectures.

our framework is able to achieve state of the art results in a single seq2seq model with a fraction of the complexity and training time of pipeline based methods.
we present a novel, holistic framework for task oriented dialogue systems which is extendable and can be optimized with both supervised learning and reinforcement learning.
we have proposed a novel, holistic framework for task oriented dialogue systems based on a single seq2seq model.

we propose a single seq2seq architecture which is simple to train and extend, scalable, and robust to out of vocabulary entities.
we simplify task oriented dialogue systems with a seq2seq model and show that a simple Two Stage CopyNet can outperform state of the art systems on large datasets.

we can simplify task oriented dialogue systems with a single seq2seq model.
a seq2seq model can be designed for task oriented dialogues and that it is more robust and scalable.
a single, end to end model is more scalable and robust than a pipeline based design.
